uiux.description: A complete redesign of a health tracking app to improve user experience and engagement.

uiux.title: SafeMom
uiux.description: A clinician-facing early-warning flow for preeclampsia risk in Kenyan antenatal clinics, designed to fit inside a routine visit instead of adding work to it.
features: Short data entry using only inputs available at the visit
Neutral risk flag with the reasons behind it
Result page redesigned from a usability and clinical-safety audit

uiux.title: PGD Blog
uiux.description: A digital publishing platform designed and built to help journalism students publish their news stories, showcase their writing skills, and reach readers beyond the classroom.
features: Student login and story publishing workflow
Public-facing platform for discovering and reading student news stories
Digital showcase for student journalism and writing portfolios
